_note: How each test question is worded on the warning screen and to the answer model in the demo (make_demo_json.py, live_server.py). Each asks for the same value as the frozen Exp 3 fill-in-the-blank question in frozen_exp3/ground_truth.json, phrased the way an analyst would ask it. The harness experiment (exp3_harness_questions.json) keeps the frozen wording, so earlier results stay comparable. The checks don't read the wording: they work from the question id and the passages.
